name: Rules
description: RULE concepts with useful limits and complications

fields.description: Create and control a few meters of thread within sight; stronger fibers require carried material, and control weakens sharply with distance.
Capture one sound and replay or redirect it; loud sounds cost more AP and only one captured sound can be held at a time.
Accelerate corrosion on touched non-magical metal; large or well-maintained objects require sustained contact.
Sense and manipulate ordinary doors nearby; cannot create passages or affect a threshold the user cannot clearly imagine.
Animate written ink into moving symbols and simple shapes; destroying the source writing ends the effect.
Produce and shape cool fog nearby; wind disperses it and the user cannot see through it naturally.
Copy the face of someone touched for one hour; voice, clothing, memories, and mannerisms remain unchanged.
Bend and reshape touched glass without heat; shattered fragments remain dangerous and mass cannot be created.
Sense when a willingly spoken promise is broken; cannot force honesty or determine why it was broken.
Increase or decrease friction across a small visible surface; extremes are brief and affect allies as readily as enemies.
Create, remove, and follow mundane scents; complex copied scents require a sample.
Fold paper into briefly animated tools or creatures; water, fire, and heavy force destroy them easily.
Create and shape a handful of salt; larger quantities cause exhaustion, and summoned salt dissolves by sunrise.
Sense nearby heartbeats and briefly synchronize with one; constructs and many undead are invisible to it.
Move or alter color on visible surfaces; effects are cosmetic but can enable camouflage or coded signals.
Stabilize a touched object or willing person against ordinary motion; sudden heavy force can overwhelm it.
Know when a designated boundary is crossed; only one boundary can be watched and it must be physically marked.
Communicate simple intentions to a small group of mundane insects; it grants no direct control over unnatural creatures.
Once per scene, nudge a trivial random outcome; the GM chooses an equally unlikely inconvenience that follows.
Briefly amplifies a charge, strike, or projectile; it cannot change the trajectory and transfers some recoil to the user.
Deflects a projectile toward a second visible surface; every bounce sharply reduces power and requires a plausible angle.
Accelerates one simple movement for a few seconds; the user’s decisions and perceptions do not speed up.
Visually conceals a motionless target; sound, tracks, and moved objects remain perceptible.
Creates or directs nearby fire; its size depends on available fuel and it remains dangerous to allies.
Rapidly removes heat from a small surface; it can form ice but cannot instantly freeze a whole creature.
Condenses humidity into local rain; the effect is weak in a very dry environment.
Accelerates closure of a recent wound; it replaces neither lost blood nor a destroyed limb.
Moves the user to a visible clear point; it fails when the route crosses consecrated protection.
Produces or guides a discharge between conductors; the user must control the current’s path.
Strengthens existing weather; it cannot create a full storm beneath a perfectly calm sky.
Grants a limited advantage to an action following a declared vow; breaking the vow immediately ends the effect.
Calls a minor entity matching a prepared symbol; it keeps its will and demands a reasonable price.
Briefly recalls a recently dead spirit into its body; each use exacts a lasting cost and the spirit may refuse.
Binds a precise penalty to a clearly stated condition; the target must be able to understand how to break it.
Transfers a small amount of vitality through contact; it cannot exceed the injuries actually inflicted.
Moves a visible object at range; mass and precision cannot both be maximized.
Strengthens an already plausible emotion or suggestion; it creates neither lasting loyalty nor action against core values.
Gives one simple order to an animated corpse; it regains neither complete memories nor lost intelligence.
Produces a credible image or sound in a limited area; it has no mass or heat of its own.
Deepens the fatigue of a calm target; pain or immediate danger can wake them.
Lets two volunteers share a sensation or emotion; great distance blurs the bond.
Briefly makes part of the body intangible; the effect cannot be maintained while carrying a heavy load.
Manifests a protective or vengeful spirit tied to a memory; it follows that memory rather than exact orders.
Creates a sensory bond with a consenting small animal; confusion and pain cross both ways.
Accelerates or guides plant growth; it requires water, nutrients, and a still-living plant.
Conveys a simple intention to an animal; it removes neither fear nor instinct.
Produces toxic, soothing, or curative spores; only one effect may be prepared and wind remains uncontrolled.
Moves or shapes a limited amount of rock; complex structures take time and knowledge of their load.
Gradually turns a small exposed area to stone; complete transformation needs repeated applications and is reversible at first.
Accelerates deterioration of dead matter; treated or protected materials decay slowly.
Raises or lowers apparent weight in a small area; inertia and structural strength do not change.
Attracts or repels nearby metals; nonmetallic objects and rare alloys react weakly.
Creates a temporary imperfect copy of the user; it shares intentions but not recent memories.
Slightly accelerates or slows a local process; it cannot rewrite the past or undo a decision.
Opens a brief passage between prepared surfaces; the same user must have marked both points.
Shows one possible future consequence of an immediate decision; changed circumstances invalidate it.
Temporarily enlarges or shrinks an object or creature; unstable mass sharply limits duration.
Directs an air current or creates a gust; the effect quickly weakens in a very large space.
Tracks or identifies someone from their blood; the sample is consumed and may be contaminated.
Thickens or moves an existing shadow; intense light reduces its reach and solidity.
Moves and compacts sand or dust; it creates no matter and becomes imprecise in rain.
Bends or joins a small amount of heated metal; enchanted alloys resist the effect.
Copies the visible appearance of an observed RULE without its full power; only one imitation may be retained.
Clarifies or blurs a memory; it cannot invent missing information and leaves detectable traces.
